page.layout: One column of text. Syriac lines are set in full width, alternating with Latin lines in italic and roman. No margin notes. Page number at head.

p.i: Custodite itaque diligenter quod vobis tradi-tum est ab Ecclesia sancta Catholica, quemad-modum didicit illa a Prophetis, atque Apostolis, & confignauit ipsi tertius Chorus Sanctorum Doctorum, qui omni tempore clarueruunt[?] in vera fide Orthodoxa, ac tanquam Sydera dirigentia in ea illuxerunt,

main_text.p: Imo sancti Patres sunt ipsis Maronitis Lampades. Officium sanctorum Basilij, & Gregorij ad Vesperas:

p.i: Benedictus est Christus, qui sibi elegit pra-cones fidei, ac tanquam lampades constituit, & illuminata est ab eis tota creatura.

page.notes: The Syriac (Maronite) text is in Syriac script. I could not read it letter by letter at this scan resolution, so every Syriac line is marked illegible with an approximate letter count. Those counts are estimates. The Latin is read from the scan; "clarueruunt" and the Latin spelling are doubtful where marked [?]. The Syriac lines are set in the main text, not as notes.
